wording: P100 adapts Reed's Self-Transcendence Scale to Spanish: 19 experts gave a global content validity coefficient S-CVI of 0.92; in 116 adults internal consistency was alpha 0.772 (test) and 0.833 (retest); scores correlated with psychological well-being (r 0.636) and spiritual well-being (0.687); the abstract reports three factors explaining 42.3% of the variance and the four- and three-factor models fit acceptably (RMSEA 0.053 and 0.049).
locator: P100 Objectives to Conclusion, Tables 1-3 (read in full)
counterevidence_limits: Small online sample; intraclass ICC 0.278 (p 0.097) is low. Slips: Bartlett 'df = 1,050' (105 for 15 items); three factors 42.3% vs four factors 41.4% elsewhere; one-factor SRMR printed 0.837; the 'no children' row total is 16 (11 + 50 = 61); Pc values for three items do not follow the stated formula (TR0-APP-02).
operationalization: APP Transcendence = self-transcendence measured in nursing research
verification_phrases: P100|global content validity coefficient (S-CVI) = 0.92 || P100|df = 1,050 || P100|three factors explained 42.3% of the variance

wording: P100's I-CVIs equal the share of agreeing experts (18/19, 17/19, 16/19, 15/18), its modified kappas follow from its printed I-CVI and Pc, S-CVI is 0.922, and RMSEA (0.053, 0.050, 0.053, 0.078) and chi-square p (0.024, 0.039, 0.023, < 0.001) reproduce for the four factor models. Two pre-registered checks were not supported: the chance agreement Pc = C(N, A) 0.5^N gives 0.00033, 0.0018 and 0.0031 for 17/19, 16/19 and 15/18, not the printed 0.0013, 0.0665 and 0.1120 (the kappas inherit them, though all stay above 0.81); and Bartlett's df for 15 items is 105, not 1,050.
counterevidence_limits: Audits printed rounded numbers; Pc formula as P100 cites it (Polit et al.).
operationalization: APP Transcendence = auditing a scale validation
